Game Keys
Movement W/A/S/D
Crouch C
Walk Shift
Dash Ctrl
Prev/Next Item Q/E
Drop Item X
Stow Sword 1/2/3
Exit Mode/Vehicle Esc
Next/Prev player model V/B
Random player model Ctrl+B
Random player customisation Ctrl+V
Gesture & Interactive Controls
Paper/Scissors/Rock NumPad 7/8/9
Perform Gesture NumPad 0-6
Shake hands with target NumPad .

Camera & Mouse Controls
Press Tab to cycle through the three camera modes:
* Normal camera;
* Orbit camera;
* Free camera.
In Free camera mode use the Arrow keys to move
the camera.
Things that you can interact with are indicated
with a title when targeted with the mouse cursor.
Left Click to "Use" the item (pick up item, attack
monster, etc).
Hold down Right Mouse Button to point the camera.
Hold down Left Mouse Button to orbit the camera
around the player.
Hold down both Left and Right buttons to move the player.
Use the Mouse Wheel to zoom the camera in and out.

General

Teleport to locations 1-4 Ctrl+1-4
Quit Alt+F4
